protocol.factorial: complete Cartesian product, no probability weights
protocol.cases: all seven frozen presets; incomplete input checked without numeric grid
protocol.kinetics: multiply whole sulfur removal exponent, not the output concentration
protocol.t95_bias: add bias*4*w*(1-w), w=(clean+heavy)/(1-additive), to nominal mixed T95
protocol.cost: multiply HT processing premium over base diesel cost 1; vary clean tank price only; additive cost 100 and max3% remain expert constants
protocol.delay: override assumed command response delay; keep every case horizon and half-hour ramp unchanged
protocol.nominal_acceptance: same frozen action feasible in all972 worlds and maximum relative cost regret <=0.05; missing/no-action case not scored as a robust recommendation
protocol.regret: candidate_cost/world_minimum_feasible_cost - 1; undefined if candidate infeasible or no feasible comparator
protocol.robust_choice: intersection of feasible candidate sets across worlds; minimize maximum regret, then nominal cost, then distance to current and fixed order; empty intersection means ABSTAIN
protocol.secondary: same tests conditional on delay<=1h, explicitly conditional, not replacement for main result
protocol.attribution: nominal plus one-factor-at-a-time worlds; per-factor failures and action switches; interactions from full factorial
protocol.limits: finite model grid sensitivity only; no confidence interval, causal validation, industrial probability or extrapolation
